column6: Metamorphosis now lets you choose the matching talent position from each of the other five classes. Tap a talent to inspect it before choosing. Your invested points transfer; already-owned talents remain unavailable.

The Community preview is now available in private testing. Explore how player submissions, discussions, qualification voting and elimination tournaments are planned to shape APD. Online participation is not available yet.
APD is in private testing. UIMSD provides local run statistics, filtering, sorting and reports. The game is still in development, and player feedback will help identify problems before wider testing.
